findings.passage: NOW THEREFORE, be it RESOLVED by the Tazewell County Board of Supervisors that the Board expresses its intent to vigorously uphold the Second Amendment rights of the law-abiding citizens of Tazewell County, Virginia.
findings.motion: Tazewell County Resolution 19-008, promoting the order of militia pursuant to the Second Amendment
findings.note: He was Chairman of the Board of Supervisors. The recorded vote lists him among the ayes (5 ayes, no nays) and he signed as Chairman. The resolution also states the Board's intent to fund concealed weapons training, to stop funding enforcement of laws it sees as infringing the right to keep and bear arms, and to oppose unconstitutional restrictions through legal means. Read from the scanned PDF.
